53/S0.subgoal: Explain the theoretical context of VR navigation optimization and the two existing approaches.

53/S1.subgoal: Describe a practical case study of a river island to frame the navigation problem within a time constraint.

53/S2.subgoal: Explain the methodology for converting a physical site into a graph representation for navigation.

53/S3.subgoal: Describe the data collection process for creating a navigation graph through field studies and contextual inquiry.

53/S4.subgoal: Explain how to translate collected data into a graph model and apply optimization solvers.

53/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and provide reference materials.
